Hi, I am Shravani. I'm a Master's student at Monash University, based in Melbourne.

Before returning to study, I worked across banking, marketing and tech. That mix is why I enjoy turning data into something people can act on, which is what this blog is about.

This site is part of my ETC5523 Communicating with Data coursework. The main post turns a research paper on climate change and Australian bushfire risk into a plain-English summary.
